ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central zones (approx. 65-70%) contrasted with low-intensity black perimeter borders and interior mottling (approx. 30-35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white geometric blobs forming the lobes, separated by a dark central axis. The left lobe contains a single prominent circular black focal spot in the mid-ventral region. The right lobe features multiple vertical black linear streaks and scattered micro-mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 70-80 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys with varying amplitudes (1-5 pixel depth).

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of roughly parallel, vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) clearly visible on the right lobe; shorter, less organized linear marks are present on the left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: The image captures several birds in the foreground and background, specifically three in the lower left/center and three in the upper background, positioned around the fluke's water-line entry.
